name: Setur
dealModel: Platform license — holidayheroes PRO B2B + B2C, Türkiye exclusive
paymentDirection: Setur pays HH (incoming revenue share + minimum commitment)
calculationBasis: GROSS GBV — end-customer price before commissions, refunds, or taxes; VAT excluded. GBV is the YSA (sub-agency) selling price to the end customer, NOT our selling price to Setur.
rate: 1.25% on GBV up to €10M/year; 1.00% above. Year-end true-up: +0.25% to HH if GBV < €10M (i.e. effective rate is always 1.25% below threshold). Invoice at 1.00% during the year; collect 0.25% at year-end.
triggerDate: Booking dates for bi-weekly settlement; departure dates for quarterly minimum true-up
merchantOfRecord: Setur (Setur POS via Craftgate) — HH never sees the card transaction
setupFee: €40,000 — 50% at signature, 50% at go-live; refundable if GBV ≥ €4M within 12 months of go-live
minimum: €3,000/month from Month 4 post go-live; invoiced as €9,000 quarterly in advance
settlementCadence: Bi-weekly booking settlement (1–15 and 16–EOM periods); quarterly minimum reconciliation vs 1.00% actual on departure dates
invoicing: HH invoices Setur for revenue share + minimum commitment; self-billing Gutschrift flow for YSA commissions runs separately inside Setur
cancellations: Credit note by HH offset against outstanding balance; prior revenue share clawed back in next settlement; TL refund may differ from TL charged if rate moved
currency: EUR commercial terms; TL on Setur POS (Craftgate). FX source and conversion date NOT fixed in Annex A — open gap. Lock EUR GBV at the charge-date rate; do not re-translate. Request TL amount + applied rate from Setur per booking.
term: 5-year fixed; no termination in first 24 months; 6-month notice from Year 3
notes: Critical open points: (1) FX clause missing — propose ECB equivalent to Setur in writing. (2) GBV must be end-customer price (line 8 in Notion), not our invoice to Setur — need agent selling price from Setur per booking or revenue share is systematically understated. (3) Confirm markup chain mechanic (price differential vs commission invoice) with Setur.
